description: TraceHurl Feature Map and Verification Test Suite Specifications

features.name: Evidence-First Ingestion & Normalization
features.description: Ingests Hurl native JSON reports, Schema v1 manifests, phase TSVs, wire request/response payloads, and correlates entries by line and index.
acceptanceCriteria: Correlates entries strictly by index and line number, not requestID.
Derives wire response payloads from assertion actuals when raw response files are omitted.
Reconstructs execution phases from exit codes and timestamps without guessing.

features.name: Superimposed Payload Contract Delta Engine
features.description: Computes key-order-independent JSON Pointer diffs between expected contracts and actual responses with superimposed and side-by-side split views.
acceptanceCriteria: Detects Added, Removed, Changed, and TypeMismatch delta kinds.
Diffs remain invariant under JSON key ordering differences.
Superimposes contract additions and removals with color-coded callouts.

features.name: Variable Provenance DAG
features.description: Tracks variable extractions, scenario setup accounts, variable lifecycle status (ok, failed, unresolved), and downstream step consumers.
acceptanceCriteria: Ingests setup accounts from created-accounts.json into scenario variable catalog.
Maps every downstream entry that references a captured variable.
Flags unresolved variables used before definition.

features.name: Automated Test-Quality Diagnostics
features.description: Statically analyzes test quality to flag entries with no assertions, weak status ranges, weak type checks, and unasserted retries.
acceptanceCriteria: Flags TQ001 for entries missing assertions.
Flags TQ002 for broad negative assertions like status >= 400.
Flags TQ003 for type-only checks without value assertions.
Flags TQ004 for undefined variable references.
Flags TQ005 for retried requests missing state assertions.

features.name: Cryptographic Artifact Integrity & Path Traversal Defense
features.description: Validates SHA-256 hashes of all referenced artifacts against manifest.json and rejects path traversal directory escape attempts.
acceptanceCriteria: Rejects artifact paths containing '..' or leading '/'.
Fails validation if SHA-256 checksum does not match manifest.
Passes validation only when all artifacts exist and match exactly.

features.name: Responsive Stitch Telemetry Viewer
features.description: Interactive single-file HTML report built with Google Stitch design system tokens, vertical independent scrolling, and synchronized failure navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Maintains responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile drawer views.
Scenario Explorer and Diagnostics list scroll independently within viewport height.
Jump to First Failure stepper automatically scrolls failed cards into view with active rings.
Default filter chip 'All' is highlighted on initial page load.

features.name: Universal Credential Redaction
features.description: Universal masking of Bearer tokens, JWT patterns, cookies, and sensitive query parameters across all rendered views and models.
acceptanceCriteria: Replaces Bearer tokens with 'Bearer [REDACTED]'.
Masks sensitive query parameters (token, secret, auth, password).
Ensures zero raw JWT strings exist in generated HTML.

features.name: Automated Failure Clustering & Root-Cause Analysis
features.description: Groups multi-entry test failures by normalized contractual error signatures, HTTP status codes, and schema diffs into actionable triage clusters.
acceptanceCriteria: Normalizes JSONPath and diff paths (array indices, UUIDs) to cluster related failures across entries.
Sorts failure clusters descending by impacted entry count.
Links failed entries to their root-cause cluster ID.
Provides suggested remediations for status mismatches, missing contract attributes, and type mismatches.
Enables 1-click cluster filtering in Scenario Explorer and dedicated Root Causes tab.

features.name: 1-Click HTTP Archive (HAR 1.2) Export
features.description: Exports entire test run wire requests, responses, timings, and headers as a standard HAR 1.2 file via CLI and interactive 1-click UI download.
acceptanceCriteria: Adheres strictly to the W3C / HTTP Archive (HAR) 1.2 specification.
Generates trace.har alongside index.html and report.json.
Supports standalone CLI export via `tracehurl export-har <RUN_DIR>`.
Provides 1-click in-browser download of HAR archive in report header and footer.
Preserves universal credential redaction across all exported HAR headers and bodies.

features.name: Cross-Run Comparison & Regression Diff Engine
features.description: Compares base and current runs to isolate fixed entries, new regressions, and latency regressions with HTML and JSON reports.
acceptanceCriteria: Identifies regressions when previously passing steps fail in the current run.
Identifies fixed entries when previously failing steps pass in the current run.
Flags steps with >50% duration increase as latency regressions.
Outputs both machine-readable comparison.json and dark-themed comparison index.html.

features.name: Flaky Test & Retry Progression Visualizer
features.description: Visualizes multi-attempt retry progressions (--retry) directly from Hurl call traces, exposing transient failures and self-healing requests.
acceptanceCriteria: Ingests all intermediate retry attempts from entry.calls instead of collapsing.
Renders retry timeline pills in report header with per-attempt status and latency.
Badges retried and flaky entries in the Scenario Explorer sidebar.
Preserves the final evaluated attempt for contract diff inspection.
